Microscope rendering uses Blender floating-point import/render precision. Exact contraction distance 1.7378896249769805e-6 meters comes from original OBJ coordinates.
All edge images use Blender ShaderNodeWireframe on actual imported triangle edges; no hand drawn or invented edges.
